<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="f-tM0NOAaLRZW7XPAU5v"> <mxGraphModel dx="2167" dy="1189" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor User as Client UI / Frontend
 participant API as FastAPI Server (AIBuddyMode/api.py)
 participant Logic as Adaptive Logic (logic.py)
 participant QGen as Question Generator (questionGeneration.py)
 participant Eval as Evaluator (evaluator.py)
 participant LLM as LLM Engine (Ollama / Gemini / Groq)

 %% Step 1: Start
 Note over User, API: Phase 1: Interview Session Initialization
 User->>API: POST /interview/start (persona, focus, max_q)
 API->>API: Generate session_id & Initialize InterviewState
 API->>Logic: pick_next_topic(state)
 Logic-->>API: returns selected topic (e.g., \"dsa\")
 API->>QGen: get_next_question(topic, difficulty, persona, asked, ...)
 alt is DSA Topic
 QGen->>QGen: fetch_leetcode_questions() (via GraphQL API)
 QGen->>QGen: Filter out already asked questions: (title not in asked)
 else is other topic (System Design, Behavioral, etc.)
 QGen->>LLM: Generate custom question matching persona & difficulty
 LLM-->>QGen: Custom question text
 end
 QGen-->>API: returns question object
 API-->>User: returns session_id, first question, difficulty, & question_number: 1

 %% Step 2: Answer Submission & Dynamic Adaptation
 Note over User, API: Phase 2: Submission and Adaptive Feedback Loop
 User->>API: POST /interview/answer (session_id, answer)
 API->>API: Retrieve InterviewState
 API->>Eval: evaluate_answer(topic, question_desc, answer, persona)
 Eval->>LLM: Evaluate correctness, time/space complexity, edge cases
 LLM-->>Eval: Return scores & weak tags JSON
 Eval-->>API: return evaluation object

 API->>Logic: apply_evaluation(state, evaluation, topic, answer)
 Note over Logic: 1. Update difficulty based on score<br/>2. Update/Decay weak area severity<br/>3. Add title to asked_questions<br/>4. Track performance history
 Logic->>Logic: _update_lock_state(state, topic, score)
 Note over Logic: If weakness severity >= LOCK_THRESHOLD,<br/>lock the topic to focus on it!
 Logic-->>API: return updated state

 alt question_count >= max_questions
 API->>API: build_report(state) & delete session
 API-->>User: returns done: true & final performance report
 else continue session
 API->>Logic: pick_next_topic(state)
 Note over Logic: Returns locked_topic if locked, otherwise<br/>picks topic weighted by worst average score
 Logic-->>API: returns next_topic
 API->>Logic: pick_target_weak_area(state, next_topic)
 Logic-->>API: returns target_weak_area
 API->>QGen: get_next_question(next_topic, difficulty, asked, target_weak_area)
 QGen-->>API: returns next_question
 API-->>User: returns done: false, evaluation, next_question, & new difficulty
 end
",
 "config": null
